name: SurrealDB MCP
tagline: Query and model data in SurrealDB from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official SurrealDB MCP server. Run SurrealQL queries, design schemas, manage records, and explore graph relationships. Multi-model database with one query language.
longDescription:
## What it is

SurrealDB's MCP server. Exposes SurrealDB as MCP tools: run SurrealQL, define schemas, manage records, traverse graph relations, and authenticate as different users.

## Why we recommend it

SurrealDB combines document, graph, and relational in one engine. The MCP server lets your agent model data, run schema-aware queries, and explore graph paths — all through a single tool surface.

## When to use it

- Schema design: agent drafts a SurrealQL schema and applies it
- Graph queries: agent traverses `->related_to->` relations and reports
- Record CRUD: agent creates/updates/deletes records with field validation
- Auth: agent switches between users/roles to verify per-row access
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. SurrealDB is open source. SurrealDB Cloud has a free tier.
